text_block_list.text:
It was one day as Valentine's Day drew 
near. Tazuna-san handed me a large 
cardboard box addressed to me.

With a pounding heart, I opened the 
box—and gasped. Inside were all kinds of 
luxurious chocolates and bouquets. On 
every single enclosed card was—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Ah, from the marriage suitors, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Given my family's standing, there are many 
who wish to be betrothed to me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
They all send me presents on every 
occasion just to win my heart, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She's focusing on her races right now, and 
I've let everyone know not to send 
anything, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems everyone is thinking of ways to 
outmaneuver the rest to make up for it."
choice_data_list:
I see... So that's why it was addressed to 
me.

I see... So that's why it was addressed to 
me.

text_block_list.text:
Sending it directly to her family home or 
to Gentildonna herself would mean it'd 
never even be opened... That's likely why 
they decided to go through the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I do appreciate those who can strategize, 
but not when their depth is so thoroughly 
shallow.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize for the trouble caused to 
you. I shall take over from here."
choice_data_list: What are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll just check who it's from, and then 
send it right back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If someone gets the approach completely 
wrong, I'll have to reconsider our future 
relationship.

One or two would be fine, but with this 
much volume... it looks like it'll take 
quite a lot of time and effort.
choice_data_list: ...Do you have a social media account?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly... I had one made 
back then in connection with our family 
business, didn't I?
choice_data_list:
Then let's reply to them all at once 
there.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Gentil-san's social media, it's 
actually updated for once—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Entrepreneur
text_block_list.text: ...! This is...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Wealthy Person
text_block_list.text:
"This is Gentildonna's Trainer. I'm 
borrowing this account to express my 
gratitude to everyone who sent gifts to 
me."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Wealthy Person
text_block_list.text:
"There was a slight clerical error, but... 
rest assured. It has reached me, and I 
have gratefully accepted all of it."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Wealthy Person
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, to all of Gentildonna's fans: 
Thank you. However, going forward, such 
consideration is unnecessary. —Trainer"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Wealthy Person
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, keeping me in check, are you? 
And here I thought you were just a soft 
touch... I see why she chose you after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder if this will calm things 
down.

Those seeking to become Gentildonna's 
fiancé seem to mostly be confident, proud 
individuals. If they sense an attempt to 
keep them at bay—
choice_data_list: I won't fall for the same trick again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How can you be so certain? I wonder if 
they'd really think that deeply about it.
choice_data_list: I kind of get how you feel, so...

text_block_list.text:
Those who walk the thorny path of pursuing 
such a magnificent Umamusume as 
Gentildonna will resort to any means, 
pushing their intellect to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words... *giggle*, how pitiful 
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I doubt they'll perceive that message as 
coming from a neutral party.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It was, so to speak, a flex from the 
"person closest to me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I hope the next thing delivered to you 
isn't a letter of challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Did you forget what day it is today?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I don't like being in anyone's debt. —Do 
you like sweets?

Where Gentildonna brought me was an 
ultra-luxurious chocolatier brand that I 
would never have set foot in on my own.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Whatever it is you desire, just say the 
word.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I came here because I deemed it a fair 
reward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Do you deem that to be excessive, I 
wonder?"
choice_data_list:
...Well, if you'll eat with me too, then 
sure.

...Well then, if you're going to eat with 
me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. Then, choose whichever you like.

Steeling my resolve, I look at the 
displayed chocolates while trying as much 
as possible to keep the price tags out of 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching from here. Please, take 
your time...

...I imagine countless challenge letters 
arriving at my doorstep. It sounds quite 
exhausting, but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you confident you can win?
choice_data_list: I don't know... But I don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you, too, are throwing your 
hat in the ring as a fiancé candidate?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I thought. The context completely 
skipped ahead, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need for you to engage in an 
unbecoming duel."
choice_data_list:
Still... I guess I'll take on the 
challenge after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list:
If you'd lose to someone like me, you're 
not worthy of them.

If losing to me is the extent of your 
abilities, you are unworthy of them.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. There's no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Poor souls, every last one of them.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they understand the height of 
the wall they must overcome—

—On Valentine's Day, I received yet 
another package addressed to me from 
Tazuna-san. With fear and trepidation, I 
opened it up to find...

"Inside was a pair of ankle weights. They 
were adorned with red jewels... spinels. 
On the accompanying card—"

"Happy Valentine's Day. Instead of sweet 
words, I give you heavy responsibilities. 
Do work hard for my sake, won't you?"
"With love, Gentildonna."
